# Monorepo Conventions

## Package Naming

| Package type | Scope | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Publishable web-component library in `libs/` | `@ssv/<name>` | `@ssv/button`, `@ssv/data-grid` |
| Example / demo app in `apps/` | `@app/<name>` | `@app/stencil-playground`, `@app/vike-playground` |

**Rules:**
- `@ssv/*` is reserved for publishable `libs/` only — do **not** use it for anything in `apps/`
- All `apps/` packages use `@app/<name>` regardless of what they consume
- `pnpm-workspace.yaml` `catalog:` entries are shared across both scopes; the scope only applies to the `"name"` field in `package.json`

## Structure: Vertical Slices (Feature-First)

Organise source files **by feature**, not by type. Each feature owns its component, styles, and state in one directory.

### StencilJS libraries and apps (`apps/stencil-playground`, future `libs/*`)

```
src/
  counter/
    counter.tsx          # @Component — tag, styles, render
    counter.css          # scoped styles
    counter.store.ts     # @stencil/store — co-located reactive state
  todo/
    todo.tsx
    todo.css
    todo.store.ts
  index.ts               # named re-exports only
  components.d.ts        # auto-generated by Stencil compiler
```

**Rules:**
- No `components/` or `store/` top-level folders — those are layer-based, not feature-based
- Store files live **inside** their feature folder (`<feature>/<feature>.store.ts`), never in a shared `store/`
- Import the store with a relative path scoped to the feature: `import { counterStore } from "./counter.store"`
- `index.ts` re-exports named symbols only — no default exports in `libs/`
- When adding a new component, create `src/<feature>/` and place all related files inside it

### Vike apps (`apps/vike-playground`, future Vike apps)

```
src/
  pages/
    counter/
      +Page.tsx          # page component — imports from @app/stencil-playground/react
    todo/
      +Page.tsx
    +Layout.tsx          # root layout
    +config.ts           # ssr, stream, head config
  app.css                # Tailwind entry + CSS custom properties
```

Feature pages co-locate their data-fetching (`+data.ts`) alongside `+Page.tsx` when needed.

## What to avoid

- **Avoid** `src/components/`, `src/hooks/`, `src/services/` — these are type-first groupings
- **Avoid** a shared `src/store/` folder — stores belong to the feature that owns them
- **Avoid** `@ssv/*` for `apps/` packages — that scope signals "publishable library"
